verified_facts.text: The hotel first opened in 1958 and had a nightclub that drew legends such as Frank Sinatra and Liza Minnelli.
verified_facts.excerpt: First opened in 1958, it was the axis for entertainment on the island, with a nightclub that drew legends like Frank Sinatra and Liza Minnelli.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has a glistening oval chandelier at its center, described as the third largest of its kind in the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: with a glistening oval chandelier—the third largest of its kind in the world—shining in the center

verified_facts.text: Designer Jeffrey Beers led a renovation, unveiled in December 2018, that modernized the common spaces, restaurants and bars while preserving the property's history.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel enlisted designer Jeffrey Beers to spearhead a $65 million renovation under the Hilton banner, unveiled in December 2018, that modernized the common spaces, restaurants, and bars while preserving the property's history and throwback elegance

verified_facts.text: The guests can choose among lounges, daybeds or luxury cabanas spread among the four pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pool dwellers can choose among the lounges, daybeds, or luxury cabanas spread among the four pools.

verified_facts.text: Dining includes the poolside Caña by chef Jose Enrique Montes, a branch of the Miami steakhouse Meat Market, and a 12-seat sushi speakeasy called Sushi By Bou.
verified_facts.excerpt: the poolside Caña by James Beard Award-nominated chef Jose Enrique Montes; a branch of the popular Miami steakhouse Meat Market; and the 12-seat sushi speakeasy, Sushi By Bou

verified_facts.text: Besides the Chandelier Bar, the hotel has a rum bar, a wine bar, a cabaret bar and a café specializing in local coffee.
verified_facts.excerpt: In addition to the Chandelier Bar, the hotel houses a rum bar, a wine bar, a cabaret bar, and a café specializing in local coffee.

verified_facts.text: Nightlife includes Chico Cabaret, a speakeasy with live entertainment, and Club Brava, a bi-level dance club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chico Cabaret, a speakeasy featuring live entertainment and Club Brava, a bi-level dance club with state-of-the-art sound and lighting

verified_facts.text: The Well & Being Spa has a fitness center with an outdoor rooftop, with classes from vertical wall yoga to water-focused workouts to indoor cycling.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Well & Being Spa has a fitness center with an outdoor rooftop (classes range from vertical wall yoga to water-focused workouts to indoor cycling).

verified_facts.text: The hotel is very close to the airport, with about 10 minutes from baggage claim to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: you can get from baggage claim to the beach in 10 minutes

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Isla Verde, a short taxi ride from Piñones, where food lovers go kiosk-hopping.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in Isla Verde, the hotel is also a short taxi away from Piñones, where food lovers kiosk-hop

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers water sports such as kayaking and parasailing, and has a tennis center onsite.
verified_facts.excerpt: from kayaking to parasailing. There’s a tennis center onsite, too.

verified_facts.text: Villa rooms are centered around a pool, with outdoor space, large bathrooms and complimentary breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Villas, meanwhile, are centered around a pool, with outdoor space, large bathrooms, and complimentary breakfast.

verified_facts.text: The Banyan Bungalow is named for the hotel's 300-year-old tree and has a terrace with garden and pool views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named for the hotel's legendary 300 year old tree, the Banyan Bungalow is thoughtfully designed to transport guests to a tropical rainforest. Walk onto your terrace to soak in the sun and appreciate the lush garden and pool views.

verified_facts.text: Rooms in the Grand Tower have ocean, pool or city views and a sitting area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms in the Grand Tower have ocean, pool or city views and enough space for a proper sitting area.

verified_facts.text: Wi-Fi is part of the resort fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wi-Fi is part of the 21 percent resort fee.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says more walkable attractions would be nice.
verified_facts.excerpt: More walkable attractions would be nice.

verified_facts.text: The highest suite tier has a baby grand piano, a private whirlpool and terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: the highest tier pulls out all the stops with a baby grand piano, private whirlpool, terraces, and more
